matches.rationale: The finding points to Appendix B equations (14)–(17) regarding attention normalization, while gt_id 1 concerns Equation (3) in the Method section about decomposition of updates into unimodal and cross-modal parts with concatenation notation issues. These are different equations addressing different defects.

The finding identifies that attention equations use sqrt(N_t) (sequence length) instead of sqrt(d) (feature dimension) for normalization, and notes this contradicts Eq. (6) which uses sqrt(d). This directly detects gt_id 2's defect about misusing N_t as the scaling divisor instead of feature dimensionality, even though the finding points to Appendix B while the ground truth notes Section 2.2.2.

The finding concerns attention normalization scaling factors, while gt_id 3 is about the inconsistent application of matrix B to the zero vector in Equation (13)'s cross-modal adaptation term. These are distinct defects in different equations.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the misuse of N_t instead of feature dimension d in attention scaling, matching gt_id 2.
